description_en: Adds firewall rules to a firewall template based on your business requirements
description_zh: 对于已创建的防火墙模板，您可以根据业务需求为防火墙模板增加防火墙规则
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-firewall-template-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --firewall-template-id ft-bcf1a7hrdq7170000 --firewall-rule Port=8080 SourceCidrIp=222.70.XX.XX RuleProtocol=TCP Remark=test --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFirewallTemplateRules

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server to which the firewall template is applied. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询轻量应用服务器的可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the firewall template
parameters.name: firewall_template_id

fields.help_en:
The port range. Valid values: 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<start port number>/\<end port number>. Example: `1024/1055`, which indicates that the port range of 1024 to 1055.

If you set RuleProtocol to ICMP, you must set Port to -1/-1
fields.help_zh:
端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055。

如果您设置的是ICMP协议，端口只能为-1/-1
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The remarks of the firewall rule
fields.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The transport layer protocol that the rule supports. Valid values:

TCP
UDP
TCP+UDP
ICMP
fields.help_zh:
传输层协议。可能值：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
ICMP：ICMP协议
fields.name: rule_protocol

fields.help_en: The source address to which you want to grant access permissions. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported
fields.help_zh: 需要设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en: The details of the firewall rule
parameters.name: firewall_rule
